Use case: identity-preserve gameplay sprite production. Derive newly drawn original animation poses from the approved Thieu Lam concept v02. Preserve exactly the monk's identity and costume: bald shaved head, expressive dark brows, warm skin, compact sturdy CHIBI body about 2.5 heads tall, big head about 40 percent of body height, strong shoulders and readable hands; saffron/ochre short-sleeved cross-collar tunic with dark-brown edging, small dark wooden prayer beads, brown waist sash, short split ochre robe panels, loose dark-brown trousers, ivory wrist and shin wraps, dark cloth shoes. Calm disciplined warrior monk. Coherent upper-left light, crisp detailed wuxia pixel clusters, selective stepped dark outlines and warm controlled palette. Simplify tiny beads/cloth details for approximately 44 logical-pixel body height; draw new gameplay poses, NEVER crop or merely shrink the concept illustration. Fixed ORTHOGRAPHIC elevated THREE-QUARTER OVERWORLD viewpoint: top planes of bald head/shoulders visible and body/face readable. Not isometric, eye-level, 3D, platform sideview, smooth anime painting or crude shapes.
Output exactly TEN fully separated complete sprites arranged TWO ROWS of FIVE equally spaced cells, true TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No labels, text, border, grid, ground shadow, checkerboard, sparkles, aura, trails, VFX or detached marks. Keep clear transparent gutters; no hands, blades or feet touch neighboring sprites. Same scale and similar head size in all ten; planted ground baseline per row. Full head, fists, feet and blade within generous margins.
Exact pose order reading left-to-right top row then bottom row: 1 idle guard, 2 idle breathing (subtle upper-body/cloth change with stationary feet), 3 walk right-leg contact, 4 walk passing pose, 5 walk LEFT-leg opposite contact, 6 walk opposite passing pose, 7 basic attack anticipation, 8 attack contact, 9 follow-through, 10 recovery to guard. Walk must alternate both legs visibly with opposite arms, not four near-identical upright stances. Stable hip center, deliberate grounded weight transfer; no jumping. Attacks show anticipation/contact/recovery with planted feet and controlled body commitment. Maintain same face, sash, robe panels, beads and wraps across every pose.
Facing DOWN/front in every pose, nose and chest toward bottom of screen; visible face. Walk DOWN toward viewer. Attack aims down-screen toward viewer using correct forearm/weapon foreshortening, never horizontal.
QUYEN / UNARMED: both hands empty in ALL ten poses, no dao/scabbard/staff. Stable fist guard; substantial readable wrapped knuckles. Heavy basic punch: anticipation right fist chambered at hip with left-hand guard; forceful right fist punch straight in facing direction, clear elbow/forearm and planted feet; shoulder follow-through; retract back to guard. Closed fist, NOT a palm spell or kick.
